cards.name: State grants
cards.text: Gain 2 money

cards.name: Power line (building)
cards.text: Anytime during the power generation phase, you may move any number of power tokens you control in adjacent tile(s) to this tile.

cards.name: Wood
cards.text: Keep this card in front of you. When burnt, increase emissions by 1.

cards.name: Coal
cards.text: Keep this card in front of you. Counts as 2 cards if burnt by a coal plant. When burnt, increase emissions by 2.

cards.name: Natural Gas
cards.text: Keep this card in front of you. Counts as 2 cards if burnt by a natual gas plant. When burnt, increase emissions by 2.

cards.name: Synthetic fuel
cards.text: Keep this card in front of you. Counts as 2 cards when burnt by any source. When burnt, increase emissions by 2.

cards.name: Income
cards.text: Gain 1 money

cards.name: Bike
cards.text: Move 2

cards.name: Community mobilization
cards.text: Reduce emissions by X, where X is the emissions level divided by 5 rounded down.

cards.name: Solar panels
cards.text: Must be placed on a plains or city tile with no other buildings. When activated, place 1 power on this tile.

cards.name: Windmill
cards.text: Must be placed on a plains or coast tile with no other buildings. When activated, place 1 power on this tile.

cards.name: Climate funding initiative (policy)
cards.text: Whenever you play a state grant card, gain an additional 1 money.

cards.name: Carbon filters (policy)
cards.text: When activated, reduce emissions by 1 for every coal power plant (of either size) on the board.

cards.name: Pipeline safety regulations (policy)
cards.text: When activated, reduce emissions by 1 for every natural gas power plant on the board.

cards.name: Carbon capture plant
cards.text: When placed, increase power demanded in this region by 1. When activated, reduce emissions by 4.

cards.name: Hydroelectric plant
cards.text: Must be placed on coast or river tile. When activated, place 2 power tokens on this tile.

cards.name: Nuclear fission plant
cards.text: When activated, place 2 power tokens and 1 nuclear waste token on this tile. If there is ever 5 nuclear waste on this tile, you lose the game. [Anytime on your turn, pay 2*X money: remove X nuclear waste].

cards.name: Transportation electrification (policy)
cards.text: When purchased, choose any region. Increase the power demanded in that region by 1. When activated, reduce emissions by 2.

cards.name: Industrial electrification (policy)
cards.text: When purchased, choose any region. Increase the power demanded in that region by 1. When activated, reduce emissions by 2.

cards.name: Recycling
cards.text: You may discard a card. If you do, draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Public transit
cards.text: Gain 1 money. Move 5. Reduce emissions by 1.

cards.name: Biophillic architecture
cards.text: Remove a dead ecosystem token from any city tile. If you do, reduce emissions by 3 and draw a card.

cards.name: Rewilding
cards.text: Move 4. Then, if you are on a non-city tile with a dead ecosystem token, remove the token and reduce emissions by 3.

cards.name: Upcycling
cards.text: Draw a card. You may remove a card in your hand or discard pile from the game. If you do, gain money equal to its cost.

cards.name: Community reforestation
cards.text: Remove a dead ecosystem token from any forest tile. If you do, reduce emissions by 3 and draw a card.

cards.name: Carbon tax
cards.text: The other player must discard a card. Gain 2 money.

cards.name: Community coastal restoration
cards.text: Remove a dead ecosystem token from any coastal tile. If you do, reduce emissions by 5 and draw a card.

cards.name: Environmental Review
cards.text: Draw a card. Until your next turn, the other player cannot purchace any buildings.

cards.name: Home weatherization
cards.text: [You may reveal and discard this card from your hand during the power generation phase.  Choose a region: decrease the power demanded of that region by 1 until the end of this phase.] Draw a card.

cards.name: Agrivoltaics
cards.text: Gain 1 money for each solar panel you control.

cards.name: Public Safety Lawsuit
cards.text: The other player must discard X cards, where X is the emissions level divided by 5, rounded down.

cards.name: Public hearings
cards.text: Draw X cards, where X is the emissions level divided by 5, rounded down.

cards.name: Income
cards.text: Gain 1 money

cards.name: Drive
cards.text: Move 3. Increase emissions by 1.

cards.name: Mining
cards.text: Gain 1 coal.

cards.name: Drilling
cards.text: Gain 1 money and 1 natural gas.

cards.name: Natural gas plant
cards.text: When activated, generate 1 power and burn 2 cards.

cards.name: Small coal plant
cards.text: When activated, generate 1 power and burn 2 cards.

cards.name: Large coal plant
cards.text: Costs (5) if replacing a small coal plant on your current tile (the small plant's card and building are removed from the game). When activated, generate 3 power and burn 4 cards.

cards.name: Wood mills (policy)
cards.text: Whenever you would gain wood cards, gain that much money as well.

cards.name: Factory
cards.text: Must be placed on a river. When activated, place a dead ecosystem token on the closest river or coast tile. If you do, draw 2 cards and increase emissions by 2.

cards.name: Offshore oil wells (policy)
cards.text: When activated, place a dead ecosystem token on any coast tile. If you do, take gain 2 natural gas cards and increase emissions by 2.

cards.name: Transportation electrification (policy)
cards.text: When purchased, choose any region. Increase the power demanded in that region by 1. When activated, reduce emissions by 2.

cards.name: Industrial electrification (policy)
cards.text: When purchased, choose any region. Increase the power demanded in that region by 1. When activated, reduce emissions by 2.

cards.name: Natural gas sweetening (policy)
cards.text: Whenever you would gain 1 or more natural gas cards, gain that many plus 1 instead.

cards.name: Coal preparation (policy)
cards.text: Whenever you would gain 1 or more coal cards, gain that many plus 1 instead.

cards.name: Coal mine methane recovery (policy)
cards.text: Whenever you would take 1 or more coal cards, also gain 1 natural gas card.

cards.name: Datacenter
cards.text: Cannot be placed on a city tile. When placed, increase the power demand of this region by 2. When activated, take a card from the shop without paying its cost and put it in your discard pile.

cards.name: Sell fuel
cards.text: You may burn 1 card. If you do, get 3 money.

cards.name: Sustainable biofuels
cards.text: Take 2 wood cards and reduce emissions by 2.

cards.name: Landfill Gas Recovery
cards.text: Move 3. Then, if you are on a city tile, reduce emissions by 2 and gain 1 natural gas.

cards.name: Deforestation
cards.text: Move 2. Then, if you are on a forest tile, place a dead ecosystem token on it. If you do, take 3 wood cards and increase emissions by 2.

cards.name: Fracking
cards.text: Gain 2 money. Place a dead ecosystem token on the nearest coast or river tile. If you do, take 2 natural gas cards and increase emissions by 2.

cards.name: Strip Mining
cards.text: Move 2. Then, if you are on a plains tile, place a dead ecosystem token on it. If you do, take 2 coal cards and increase emissions by 2.

cards.name: Wastewater injection
cards.text: Place a dead ecosystem token on your current space. If you do, gain 3 money and increase emissions by 2.

cards.name: Negligent gas leak
cards.text: Gain 3 money, then increase emissions by 1 for each natual gas plant you control.

cards.name: Gasification
cards.text: Return up to a total of up to 4 wood or coal cards to the shop, and gain that many synthetic fuel cards. Increase carbon emissions by 1 for each synthetic fuel made this way.

cards.name: Greenwashing
cards.text: [You may reveal and play this card from your hand during the power generation phase. If you do, choose a region where you have power token(s): until the end of this phase, you are considered to have the majority of power tokens in that region.] Draw a card.

cards.name: Natural Gas Fractionation
cards.text: You may burn any number of natrual gas cards in front of you. Gain 3 money for each natural gas card burnt this way.
